preconditions.description: The input integer n must be between 1 and 10^6 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n integers.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= int(stdin.strip()) for x in return_value.split())
postconditions.description: Each integer in the output must be between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value == ' '.join(str(x) for x in sorted([1] * (int(stdin.strip()) - 1) + [int(stdin.strip())], reverse=True))
postconditions.description: The output must be the lexicographically maximum sequence of GCDs obtained by the transformation process.
